title: Instructor mode: teacher guides + answer keys wrapping the corpus
context: open-coding-curriculum is an open CC-BY (prose) / MIT (code) curriculum of beginner programming lessons with graded, runnable exercises across languages. Every exercise carries a reference solution proven correct in CI (solutionVerified:true), learner code runs zero-install in-browser via WASM, and all content is machine-readable structured data so third parties can build on it. The project targets absolute beginners — self-learners, public-library patrons, under-resourced school students, career-changers — and operates under a donated-compute lane with no server-side execution of learner code and no partner confirmed yet (verifiedNeed:false). Classroom partners need teacher guides and answer keys that wrap the corpus for instructor use, while the learner site remains spoiler-free. This feature unlocks the institutional adoption path (libraries, schools, community orgs) and is enabled by the CC-BY license that allows such adaptation.
objective: Produce teacher guides and answer keys for the Python module lessons, formatted for instructor use in classroom or code-club settings, while keeping the public learner site spoiler-free.
acceptanceCriteria: Teacher guides are produced for all Python module lessons (batches A, B, C), including: learning objectives, suggested pacing, common beginner mistakes to watch for, discussion questions, and adaptation notes.
Answer keys are provided in a separate, instructor-gated format (not on the public learner site) with full reference solutions and pedagogical commentary.
Teacher guides carry CC-BY-4.0 attribution and are formatted for print/offline use.
At least one classroom partner reviews the guides for fitness-for-purpose before they are published.
The learner site's lesson pages remain spoiler-free (no reference solutions or answer keys exposed to learners).
output: A merged set of teacher guide documents and answer key materials for the Python module, formatted for instructor use and gated from the public learner site.
